validation_exceptions: Generic Fury Docker validation is not applicable to this local JetBrains plugin.

tasks.title: Add version-adaptive split support
tasks.description: Implement runtime capability detection for modern ToolWindow splitting and the isolated build-243 legacy adapter. Fail closed to single-pane mode when neither capability is available.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Modern and legacy capabilities are probed without static linkage to version-specific classes
AC-2: Split Right, Split Down, and Unsplit resolve for supported runtimes
GATE: Plugin still compiles against IntelliJ Platform 2024.3

tasks.title: Bind UI commands to session IDs
tasks.description: Introduce SessionUiBinding and ID-specific model and effort updates. Separate the panel-local command target from the last-focused global session.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Bound commands use the owning session even when another session is globally active
AC-2: Model, effort, and sequence gating operate per session
GATE: Lifecycle binding rejects attach after disposal and destroys at most once

tasks.title: Integrate recursive split-aware content management
tasks.description: Update AgentToolWindowFactory to use focused managers, recursive contents, focus activation, and synchronized startup lifecycle. Preserve disposer-only teardown.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Split and unsplit preserve Content and session identity
AC-2: New tabs and History target the focused group with a safe root fallback
AC-3: Diff operations reach recursive split contents
GATE: Close during startup cannot attach a disposed terminal

tasks.title: Add split actions and bound toolbar behavior
tasks.description: Expose move and new-session split actions and refactor the toolbar and local terminal shortcuts to use SessionUiBinding.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Move Right, Move Down, Unsplit, and New Session in Split are discoverable
AC-2: Every panel-local action uses its bound session
GATE: Existing single-pane behavior remains unchanged

tasks.title: Add regressions and release metadata
tasks.description: Cover capability selection, binding, routing, and lifecycle logic, then prepare the complete Prism 1.4.0 version surfaces and user documentation.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: New pure logic has at least 80 percent coverage
AC-2: Version 1.4.0 is consistent across all required release files
GATE: Unit tests and buildPlugin pass on the build-243 baseline

tasks.title: Run final code review
tasks.description: Review the complete diff for correctness, compatibility, maintainability, and lifecycle regressions. Resolve all actionable findings.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Review distinguishes introduced issues from pre-existing risks
GATE: No unresolved critical, major, or minor finding

tasks.title: Run performance review
tasks.description: Verify split operations do not restart sessions or add blocking work to the EDT and recursive scans remain bounded.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: No process recreation occurs for split or unsplit
GATE: No unresolved performance finding

tasks.title: Run security review
tasks.description: Review fixed reflection targets, session command isolation, errors, and dependency changes for security regressions.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Reflection accepts no user-controlled class or method names
GATE: No unresolved security finding
